type.reflected: Reflected XSS occurs when user input is immediately returned in server responses without proper escaping.
type.stored: Stored XSS occurs when user input is stored by the server and later rendered in a page without sanitization.
type.dom_based: DOM-based XSS occurs when client-side scripts write unsanitized input into the DOM.
type.blind: Blind XSS occurs when the attacker cannot see the result directly and must infer success from triggered actions.

prevention.encoding: Encode user input before inserting it into HTML or attributes.
prevention.validation: Validate input types and lengths, but do not rely on validation alone.
prevention.content_security_policy: Use CSP to reduce the impact of XSS vulnerabilities.
prevention.http_only_cookies: Set cookies to httpOnly to reduce exposure to client-side scripts.
